title: What is waiting on me: the Specs list, waiting runs, and Work on a phone
summary: One number, specs to decide plus runs waiting on an answer, on the Work button, the tabs and the tab title; the Specs list grouped by who must act with a review state on each row and a search field; runs grouped as needs you, in motion and finished; a proposal's bar says when a run waits on it; on a phone at most two sheets, one expanded, and the map keeps 35%. The persona node is an archetype for the scenarios, not something to build.

add.desc: Pure: which specs are to decide and which runs need an answer, the one number, the Specs groups (to decide, with the agent, approved, drafts) and the run groups (needs you, in motion, finished).

scenarios.title: The maintainer at a desk sees what waits on them and answers it

steps.text: The listing carries each spec PR's review state, kept by its head.
Two specs have no review at their current hash and one run is waiting: the number is 3.
The Work button says Work 3. It opens on Runs, where the question has waited longest.
Specs lists To decide first, oldest first; each row says by whom and when it was last reviewed.

scenarios.title: On a phone, the maintainer answers a run that asks about the proposal under review

steps.text: The proposal bar says a run is waiting on you, with Answer.
Answer expands Work; the proposal folds to a 44 px stub and the map keeps 296 px.
The run is first, under Needs you; Continue is one tap away.
A tap on the stub brings the review back, and Work folds in its place.
